definitions.explanation: Bags, suitcases, or packages that one carries when traveling. Can also refer to parcels or cargo.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}を{持|も}ちましょうか。
{荷物|にもつ}が{多|おお}いですね。
examples.english: You have a lot of luggage.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}はどこに{置|お}きますか。
examples.english: Where should I put the luggage?

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}を{車|くるま}に{入|い}れてください。{大|おお}きいですから、{気|き}をつけて。
examples.english: Please put the luggage in the car. It's big, so be careful.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}で{荷物|にもつ}を{送|おく}りました。{明日|あした}には{届|とど}くと{思|おも}います。
examples.english: I sent my luggage at the station. I think it will arrive tomorrow.

notes:
Counter: {個|こ} for pieces of luggage.

Common expressions:
- {荷物|にもつ}を{預|あず}ける (to check luggage)
- {手|て}{荷物|にもつ} (hand luggage/carry-on). At Japanese train stations
- you'll often see coin lockers for storing {荷物|にもつ}.
